english.title: Fail to comply with requirements of notice under section 85(1) of the Water Industry Act 1991
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed without reasonable excuse to comply with the requirements of a notice served on you under section 85(1) requiring you to furnish such information, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION..), as was reasonably required by **(..SPECIFY LOCAL AUTHORITY..) for the purpose of exercising or performing a power or duty conferred or imposed on that authority by or under sections 77 to 82 of the Water Industry Act 1991
